items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded reversible growth. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Data quality is yellow for analytics source errors or permissions. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases; permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior; continue the existing read-only evidence matrix.

Continue the existing bounded read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness.
